purpose: Learn where the final WIN market systematically overvalues or undervalues horses using pre-race L1.7 information, without turning the critic into another ranking king.

architecture.market_baseline: LightGBM using market-only horse/race price features
architecture.l1_baseline: LightGBM using L1.7 horse/race features only
architecture.market_critic: LightGBM using market features plus L1.7 features and explicit L1-vs-market gaps
architecture.primary_direction: negative = market overvalued; positive = market undervalued

critic_bands.threshold_source: chronological last 20 percent of prior training races, predicted by fit-only models

evaluation.market_error_check: Within critic bands, compare actual outcome rate to market-only predicted rate
evaluation.flat_win_roi_proxy: Final historical WIN odds, 100-yen-equivalent flat stake; diagnostic only

market_policy.closing_odds_warning: Research measures ability to criticize the closing market; live deployment must use an available pre-race odds snapshot instead.
